title: Kinemantik Instant Messenger/Loid
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - All ending conversations (where the Hex goes offline) will be marked as {Convo. Ends}
- A flow chart will be included after all possible choices in the conversation are noted in this page
- Any glowing, golden text marked in-game will be highlighted here in bold+underlined
- Indented messages are the continuation after the Drifter (you) selected the chat option
- All user's choices to be made are marked with a '>' for clarity. Note that available choices in-game are not written in order on this page.

POM2_LAB1: Drifter. Forgive me for the impropriety of this imposition, I did not wish to contact you using this device. But this is verging on an emergency and I did not know to whom else I could turn.
- > POM2_LAB1?
- > Who is this...?
- POM2_LAB1: Ah, yes. This is still on default settings. This is Loid. I should have... led with that, but matters here in the Sanctum Anatomica have been deeply chaotic of late.
- POM2_LAB1: Which is why I am contacting you. I am in need of your assistance. Three protoframes have arrived here, in the Sanctum, in my time. And not ones previously known to us.
- POM2_LAB1: One of them is an
- POM2_LAB1: Apologies
POM2_LAB1: One of them is Orokin, Drifter.
> Where's the Lotus?

- POM2_LAB1: The Lotus and the Operator have other matters to attend to, believe me. They have been taxed well and truly enough to their limits as it is. I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
> Oh no...
- POM2_LAB1: I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
> What?!
- POM2_LAB1: I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
- POM2_LAB1: You are... seemingly the new expert in matters of this kind.

- POM2_LAB1: I do not know how to best describe them. But if you come to the Sanctum, I believe it will be hard to miss them. Two of them have agreed to speak to you here on the POM-2. One may need some further convincing.
- POM2_LAB1: I have... faith... you will be successful. {Convo. Ends}
Reunion Spoilers ▾▾
- POM2_LAB1: Drifter. I relent. Roathe, Marie, and Lyon have convinced me that the time has finally come.

- POM2_LAB1: I dread what I must do down to the marrow of my bones. Indeed, that may be what is removed from me when I am torn limb from limb in a fit of rage when Gomaitru and her family discover what has been going on beneath their feet this entire time.
POM2_LAB1: So strange to call her by that name now; but so much between us has changed. And so much more shall, in short order.
- > This is long overdue. You'll be fine.
- > You can do this.

- POM2_LAB1: Yes, well. Do kindly please come and ensure that my entrails are not being used as festive decor in the Necralisk, will you? I fear I may need a bit of reassurance, when all is said and done. {Convo. Ends}
